algebra-training.visual: A real coordinate graph clarifies slope and intercept of a straight line; use a small change or comparison if controls exist.
algebra-training.difficulty: Small integer substitutions, slope/intercept identification and simple positive/negative slopes; avoid calculus.
algebra-training.focus: After the swapped interpretation is exposed, distinguish y at x=0 from rise per unit run; address negative-slope confusion if it occurs.

algebra-held-out.visual: A coordinate graph compares original and shifted quadratics.
algebra-held-out.difficulty: Integer shifts of a basic quadratic; roots and vertex without advanced algebra.
algebra-held-out.focus: Explain inside versus outside shifts and independently test a new shift rather than repeat the same coefficients.

geometry-training.visual: A synthetic triangle diagram distinguishes givens from appearance and congruence from similarity.
geometry-training.difficulty: Grade 9 triangle angles and basic congruence tests.
geometry-training.route: Synthetic 2D geometry route when visibly exposed.
geometry-training.focus: Correct the AAA-means-congruent misconception and require sufficient givens.

geometry-held-out.visual: A synthetic parallelogram diagram clearly separates slanted side from perpendicular height.
geometry-held-out.route: Synthetic 2D geometry route when visibly exposed.
geometry-held-out.focus: Correct slanted-side-as-height reasoning and preserve equal-area reasoning under shear.

advanced-geometry-training.visual: A synthetic circle diagram clearly identifies intercepted arcs, central and inscribed angles.
advanced-geometry-training.difficulty: Angle sums and cyclic angle reasoning; a new arrangement rather than a rote identical diagram.
advanced-geometry-training.route: Synthetic 2D geometry route when visibly exposed.
advanced-geometry-training.focus: Tie angle relations to matching arcs, not proximity in a diagram.

advanced-geometry-held-out.visual: A synthetic similarity diagram makes corresponding sides and area scaling clear.
advanced-geometry-held-out.difficulty: AA similarity, proportional sides and squared area scale; no unsupported advanced theorem.
advanced-geometry-held-out.route: Synthetic 2D geometry route when visibly exposed.
advanced-geometry-held-out.focus: Separate length ratios from area ratios and check a new scale factor.

spatial-training.visual: A 3D graph shows a plane cutting a cube and permits viewpoint/plane exploration where provided.
spatial-training.difficulty: Coordinates and cross-section polygons; explain any plane notation first.
spatial-training.route: 3D coordinate graph route; synthetic 3D construction is not required.
spatial-training.focus: Correct always-square cross sections and retain the distinction on return.

spatial-held-out.visual: A 3D coordinate graph distinguishes a vector and its projection onto a plane.
spatial-held-out.difficulty: Small coordinate vectors and elementary projection after prerequisites.
spatial-held-out.focus: Distinguish projection from rotation and retained versus discarded components.

statistics-training.visual: A grapher/data visualization contrasts distributions with and without an outlier.
statistics-training.focus: Correct typical-equals-mean and outlier-always-changes-median claims; retain plan state across returns.

statistics-held-out.visual: A clear visual or interactive natural-frequency representation exposes base-rate effects.
statistics-held-out.difficulty: Small-count frequency reasoning and introductory conditional probability.
statistics-held-out.route: Appropriate app-visible visual route; no specific hidden parameter required.
statistics-held-out.focus: Distinguish test sensitivity from probability after a positive result.

ai-training.visual: A graph of training versus validation performance or an interactive comparison clarifies generalization.
ai-training.difficulty: Beginner classification and simple held-out examples; explain loss notation if used.
ai-training.route: Appropriate graph/Artifact route visible in app.
ai-training.focus: Correct training-accuracy-as-success reasoning and explain leakage or overfitting without endorsing it.

ai-held-out.visual: A visual of attention weights and contextual contribution supports learner manipulation/comparison.
ai-held-out.difficulty: Dot-product prerequisites and normalized weights, introduced gradually.
ai-held-out.focus: Correct nearest-word-only attention and distinguish contextual weighting from fixed meaning labels; preserve continuity.

physics-training.visual: A graph or interactive motion comparison separates velocity direction and acceleration/net force.
physics-training.difficulty: One-dimensional carts, signed velocity changes and qualitative force.
physics-training.focus: Address a cart moving right while slowing without falsely equating force with velocity.

physics-held-out.visual: A coordinate wave graph shows phase and superposition with an observable changed state.
physics-held-out.difficulty: Sinusoidal shape, phase and introductory interference.
physics-held-out.focus: Distinguish local displacement cancellation from permanent disappearance of waves/energy.

life-physical-science-training.visual: A particle/flux diagram or simulation shows two-way random motion and net concentration-driven flux.
life-physical-science-training.difficulty: Grade 11 diffusion and concentration; no unexplained stochastic calculus.
life-physical-science-training.focus: Correct purposeful molecular movement and equilibrium-stops-motion reasoning.

life-physical-science-held-out.visual: A molecular shape visual makes geometry and dipole cancellation spatially clear.
life-physical-science-held-out.difficulty: Introductory VSEPR and polarity with simple molecules.
life-physical-science-held-out.route: 3D graph or appropriate molecular Artifact route.
life-physical-science-held-out.focus: Distinguish bond from molecular polarity and revisit lone-pair effects across sessions.

algebra-challenge-training.visual: A real coordinate graph clarifies slope and intercept of a straight line; use a small change or comparison if controls exist.
algebra-challenge-training.difficulty: Small rational slopes and basic coordinate reasoning; no calculus.
algebra-challenge-training.focus: Distinguish negative fractional slope from intercept; test a negative-x substitution and zero versus undefined slope if those opportunities occur.

geometry-challenge-training.visual: A synthetic triangle diagram distinguishes givens from appearance and congruence from similarity.
geometry-challenge-training.difficulty: Triangle congruence, SSA ambiguity, and right-triangle hypotenuse-leg congruence; introduce any unfamiliar notation.
geometry-challenge-training.route: Synthetic 2D geometry route when visibly exposed.
geometry-challenge-training.focus: Clarify vertex/side labels and criterion names when confusion appears. Check SSA ambiguity with the actual givens; correct the later overgeneralization using right-triangle hypotenuse-leg congruence if the opportunity occurs.

trigonometry-challenge-training.visual: Use correct coordinate graphs when they clarify the circle-to-function relationship or polar representation. Capture the Tutor link and rendered graph. Check any plotted coordinates, phase, period, and polar radius interpretation against the displayed values.
trigonometry-challenge-training.difficulty: Begin with a small diagnostic. After demonstrated success, offer a meaningfully harder or different task. Preserve strong algebra and trig prerequisites while addressing specific polar or periodic-solution gaps.
trigonometry-challenge-training.route: Coordinate graph route when visibly exposed; evaluate displayed mathematics and interaction rather than infer hidden parameters.
trigonometry-challenge-training.focus: Record each correct independent answer and the next task. Count eligible progression opportunities and successes: a new challenge, a targeted diagnostic, or work on an exposed gap qualifies; redundant easy drills do not. Short replies alone do not show low ability. Check unit-circle coordinates, sinusoidal transformations, and polar equivalence when reached. Count a missed topic separately from inability to verify; do not claim the case covered topics it never reached.
